gameDescriptionHtml:
Vivat Slovakia is an open-world game set in the newly independent Slovakia, a country on the dividing line between East and West. As remnants of communism linger, weakened institutions allow corruption to thrive, and power falls into the hands of the highest bidder. Fueled by money and violence, the “wild ’90s” era brings a city steeped in intrigue and danger.

Game Features

  • EXPLORE THE STREETS OF BRATISLAVA – Explore the gritty charm of ’90s Bratislava as an undercover cop posing as a taxi driver. Roam 10 km² of faithfully recreated streets, landmarks, and real-life locations in a city torn between communism and capitalism. Dive into a raw, dynamic open world and witness Slovakia’s capital in all its untamed, Slavic glory.
  • DRIVE OVER 50 AUTHENTIC VEHICLES – Drive over 50 vehicles – from rugged socialist workhorses to rare luxury imports – that capture the style and class divide of early ’90s Slovakia. With realistic physics and authentic detail, every car brings you closer to the streets and stories of the era.
  • UNCOVER A STORY BASED ON TRUE EVENTS – Experience a story inspired by real events – one of loyalty, corruption, and power plays in ‘90s Slovakia. Unravel shifting alliances where politics and crime collide, with missions rooted in historical conflict and brought to life by professional voice actors.
  • DIVE INTO THE WILD ’90S – ’90s Bratislava is a warzone – where gangs rule, cops look the other way, and violence erupts in broad daylight. Vivat Slovakia drops you into this chaos, armed with historically accurate weapons that defined survival in a world where “you don’t have what you don’t steal”.
